objective: Create a working Ruxbase frontend from a repository-provided template, without invented credentials or backend changes
acceptance: Both outputs npm-ci-installable with committed package-lock.json and framework-buildable
Both serve health via trusted same-origin /api proxy
Browser renders white/black brand and true black night background
Two user sessions cannot access another user's unpublished post
Never expose a DB URL or admin credential in frontend
limitations: Deterministic executable scaffolding and two-user security acceptance; separate opt-in real-model tool-choice benchmark in starters/ai-model-tasks.json is not automatically executed. No arbitrary model source is run.
